title: FailureModeIndex
description: Machine-readable failure mode taxonomy generated from challenges/ by scripts/build_failure_index.py. One entry per numbered failure mode file, including merged stubs.

active_count.description: Number of entries whose status is active.

id.description: Failure mode number N, referenced as §N.

title.description: Title from the '## N. Title' heading.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the source file.

status.description: Active failure modes carry full content.

frequency.description: Frequency label from the metadata line, such as Common or Situational.

detectability.description: Detectability label from the metadata line.

token_spend.description: Token spend label from the metadata line.

time.description: Time cost label from the metadata line.

context.description: Context cost label from the metadata line.

signature.description: Observable trigger from the **Signature:** line; match this without knowing the cause.

tier.description: Minimum caller capability the workaround demands (see challenges/triage.md).

fallback.description: Single degraded action for weak models. Present exactly when tier is C.

limitation.description: What the workaround cannot compensate for.

requirements.description: Requirements that address this failure mode, from requirements/index.md.

triage_rows.description: Rows of the triage decision table that route to this failure mode.

problem.description: Markdown body of the The Problem section.

workaround.description: Markdown body of the Agent Workaround section, including its Signature, Tier, Fallback, and Limitation lines.

title.description: Title of the retired failure mode.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the merged stub.

status.description: Merged numbers are never reused; follow merged_into.

merged_into.description: Active failure mode that now covers this content.
